execution.reads: Run both implementations against the same restored fixture database.
execution.mutations: Restore an isolated copy before each implementation and compare response plus resulting database state.
execution.componentConfig: Compare GET, import and export recursively, including version, filtering, sentinel guards and transaction rollback.

normalization.generatedUuid: map by fixture insertion order only when the request omitted id
normalization.timestamps: replace valid generated timestamps with <timestamp>; preserve null versus absent

failurePolicy: Any difference not explicitly listed in the OpenSpec change fails the migration gate.
